description: Implementation of mDNS client functionality, including socket handling, packet processing, and DNS record management within the net namespace.

classes.name: MDnsConnection
classes.description: Handles UDP socket communication for mDNS, including socket creation, sending, receiving, and error handling.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for mDNS client, managing socket connections, packet parsing, cache, and listeners.

classes.name: MDnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Represents a listener for mDNS records of specific types and names, manages refresh scheduling and delegate notifications.

classes.name: MDnsTransactionImpl
classes.description: Manages DNS query transactions, including cache queries, network queries, and callback handling.

methods.name: CreateSockets
methods.description: Creates and binds mDNS sockets for each network interface.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the socket handler, binds to local address, and begins listening for datagrams.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop for receiving datagrams asynchronously.

methods.name: OnDatagramReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming datagrams and triggers processing or error handling.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Queues and sends data over the socket.

methods.name: SendDone
methods.description: Callback invoked after send completes, manages send queue.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the MDns connection with socket factory.

methods.name: SendQuery
methods.description: Constructs and sends a DNS query for a given RR type and name.

methods.name: HandlePacket
methods.description: Parses incoming DNS packets, updates cache, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: NotifyNsecRecord
methods.description: Handles NSEC records, updates cache, and alerts listeners about non-existent records.

methods.name: OnConnectionError
methods.description: Handles connection errors, potentially recreating connection and flushing cache.

methods.name: QueryCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached DNS records matching criteria.

methods.name: StartListening
methods.description: Begins listening for mDNS packets, sets up core and sockets.

methods.name: StopListening
methods.description: Stops listening and cleans up core.

methods.name: CreateListener
methods.description: Creates a new mDNS record listener.

methods.name: SetActiveRefresh
methods.description: Enables or disables active refresh for a listener.

methods.name: HandleRecordUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to DNS records, schedules refreshes, and notifies delegate.

methods.name: ScheduleNextRefresh
methods.description: Schedules the next refresh based on TTL and last update time.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Triggers a DNS query for the record.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the transaction, performs cache query and network query if needed.

methods.name: TriggerCallback
methods.description: Invokes the result callback with the specified result and record.

methods.name: ServeRecordsFromCache
methods.description: Serves cached DNS records to the transaction.

methods.name: QueryAndListen
methods.description: Performs DNS query and sets up listening for responses.
